minimalProductAdapter: run qlmanage preview in a private bounded directory and accept exactly one regular qlpreview package
validate PreviewProperties and bounded UTF-8 HTML; reject symlinks, external URLs, scripts, oversized resources, and ambiguous output
split only exact form-feed page-boundary nodes while copying shared style nodes to every local page
invoke a packaged signed universal WKWebView helper with JavaScript and network disabled and read access limited to the sealed preview root
atomically return ordered page receipts with pageId, PNG sha256, dimensions, byte count, and nonblank pixel facts
supply ordered bounded page images to the existing modelAttachments array and keep raw preview HTML out of model context
bind output-quality render coverage to exact observed page IDs; use a separate typed glyph/visual observer rather than treating file existence or distinct hashes as semantic proof
counterTests: three form-feed pages produce exactly three ordered nonblank distinct fixture images with exact marker recovery
single page without a form feed stays one page
form-feed text outside the exact boundary node does not split a page
shared nested CSS is present in every derived page
script, network URL, root escape, symlink, oversized HTML/resource, ambiguous qlpreview, and helper crash fail closed
page count mismatch or partial page output never promotes a receipt
Quick Look thumbnail output cannot satisfy all-page coverage
LibreOffice blank identical pages fail the fixture even though three PNG files exist

verdict.reason: the native path preserves and renders all three Korean pages, but safe preview-package validation, packaged helper integration, all-page receipts, and downstream projection tests do not exist yet
